text:
julia: Quick heads up — I'm pausing the py/ts SDK final publish for the evening window.

julia: Deploy-bot reported canary failures after our KMS token rotation, 2/5 runners showing signer/checksum mismatch. Not confident to cut GA.

dev-deploy-bot: canary-run #9823 finished: 3 OK, 2 FAIL. Failures flagged as 'package-signature-mismatch' on upload step. Repro steps attached in job artifacts.

alec: Ack. Do we know if it's a twine/GPG signing problem or artifact corruption from the build host?

priya: From a quick look at the artifact logs it's the signature header that differs, looks like new key prefix. Probably a key-id rotation at CI -> signing mismatch.

jamal: If it's just a signing key rotation we can pin the current dist-tag to the existing build for now and re-run signing pipeline with the new key after validation. Safer than rollback.

release-manager: Suggestion: hold the final cut, pin canary users to last-stable dist-tag, and open a hotfix cut only if we can't re-sign within 2 hours.

alec: Proposed concrete steps: 
1) Run: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@0.9.7 canary-temp` and `pip index install --use-deprecated=legacy-resolver` — jk on the pip command, but basically pin references for internal smoke.
2) Re-run the sign job with the legacy key in a hermetic env (see ops/signing-runbook).
3) If re-sign fails: publish 0.9.8-hotfix with proper key and deprecate 0.9.7-canary.

priya: I'll update release-notes draft with an advisory: "Users may see checksum/signature warnings if they upgraded during the key rotation window. We recommend reinstalling from the pinned stable tag or upgrading to the hotfix once published."

julia: Who can update the SDK quickstart and the docs snippet about verification? (we need a short blurb under "Troubleshooting: package signatures")

jamal: I'll do the docs blurb. Will add the exact `gpg --verify dist/*` example and note the temporal advisory.

release-manager: Communication plan: post a short note to #general + changelog entry pointing to the advisory, include rollback criteria (if >10% CI/production smoke fail after re-sign attempt).

alec: Devops action: I'll run the re-sign in a test runner now and report back in ~15m. If green, we proceed with normal cut and amend release notes with key rotation note. If not, we hold for hotfix.

dev-deploy-bot: re-sign-job #1245 started by alec. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/signing/verify/1245.

priya: I'll hold off pushing the final dist-tag until we see the re-sign result.

julia: Thanks all — holding the window. I'll ping legal/compliance if we need an official rotation advisory. :thumbsup:

alec: update: re-sign job passed in the hermetic runner, signatures now match expected prefix.

dev-deploy-bot: canary-run #9823 re-run: 5/5 OK.

priya: OK to proceed with cut. I'll flip the dist-tag and push release notes (short advisory about the key rotation and what to do on checksum warnings).

release-manager: Final checklist before cut: confirm docs blurb (jamal), release note published (priya), monitoring alerts set for first hour, and support on standby.

jamal: Docs blurb posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/release-notes#signature-rotation (short link).

priya: Release notes live. Pushing dist-tag now.

dev-deploy-bot: publish job #4479 started.

julia: Great job. We'll monitor and follow up if any customers report issues. Closing thread after final verification in 1 hour. :rocket:
